_note: Interest on a loan for higher education: an individual, "amount paid as interest during a tax year … on a loan taken by him from any financial institution or any approved charitable institution, if the — (a) loan taken is for the purpose of pursuing higher education of himself or his relative; and (b) payment is made out of his income chargeable to tax" (s.129(1), p.165) — no limit on the amount; "in respect of the initial tax year and seven tax years immediately succeeding the initial tax year, or until the interest … is fully paid … whichever is earlier" (s.129(2)); the initial tax year is "the tax year in which the assessee starts paying the interest" (s.129(3)(d)); a relative is the spouse, children, or a student the individual is guardian of (s.129(3)(e)). The span is the definition (TaxYearSpan); the lender, the relative and payment out of taxable income are entry conditions. rulebook DED-80E-001, -002. Old regime only (s.202(2)(a)(xii), p.227). TY 2026-27 only; the 1961 counterpart, s.80E, is unread (W-075d). D-139.
